newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT-FTSE-100 seen meeting resistance at 4,063.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-FTSE-100 seen meeting resistance at 4,063.

text.p: The FTSE 100, poised to breach its record high set earlier this week, is likely to run up against chart resistance at 4,063 in the near term, technical analysts said.
The FTSE 100 closed at 4,042.1 on Thursday, up 17.7 points.
Tom Pelc, a technical analyst with MMS International, said the bias in the market is still bullish, but momentum appears to be waning.
"The DMI (direction momentum index) suggests the market is still positive, but the trend is not that firm. We still can go higher, but the move will be more gradual," he said.
Since September 24, FTSE 100 has gained almost 3.5 percent.
Pelc said further resistance lies at 4,080, with major psychological resistance at 4,100.
The 4,020 level, which coincides with a trendline, is likely to serve as strong support for the market.
Falling below the 4,020 mark would portend a further decline to 4,000. Major longer-term support is pegged at 3,981, technical analysts said.
